name: Berry Protein Shake
why: The safety net. When a meal gets skipped, this is what closes the gap without cooking anything.

serves.proteinMath: 24 g from 1 scoop of whey (the label figure used across every shake in this app) plus 8 g from 250 ml of milk (2%, roughly 3.2 g per 100 ml). Total 32 g. The frozen berries and the optional cocoa and honey add under a gram between them and are not counted in the headline number.

steps.text: Put 250 ml of milk in the blender jar first, then 1 scoop of whey, then 1 handful of frozen berries. If you want it, add 1 tsp of cocoa powder and 1 tsp of honey now too.
steps.look: 250 ml is one full cup, or the jar filled to just under half. Liquid first genuinely matters. Powder on the bottom cakes against the blades and leaves a dry lump that never mixes.
Done when there are no visible flecks of powder and the colour is even. Frozen berries make it thick and cold, which is the point, so no ice needed.
32 g of protein: 24 g whey, 8 g milk. Takes two minutes and needs no heat, so there is never a good reason to end the day short.

provenance.statement: WRITTEN BY AN AGENT. No published source. Nobody has cooked these quantities. Treat every number as a first draft. There is no heat or doneness judgment anywhere in this one, which is why it is offered despite having no source: nothing here can burn.
